player_intent: A coherent copied SOCOM-source jump with continuous takeoff/air poses, matched landing entry and stable rifle/pistol contact, rather than mismatched running/standing phases.
acceptance_rule: Main and hybrid maps share phase windows and anchor_hips_at_takeoff. Capture hip translation once on airborne entry into operator-local jump clips; never mutate another operator or the shared cache. Standing and running AK/Mark23 jumps stay within 4 cm of hip translation per physics tick. Choose running or standing launch once, enter airborne at apex or immediately for a ledge fall, map landing to the existing recovery interval, exclude terminal closure, retain hands within 1 cm without arm stretch in AK/M4/Mark23 jumps and accepted-shot recovery. Keep support-wrist grasp within 1 degree of its last grounded weapon-relative orientation; clear on re-equip. Never change CharacterBody trajectory or gameplay permissions.

nodes.role: Existing animation graph and final weapon contact presentation

must_not_change: Standing ready/fire and ordinary pistol hybrid
visual_check: Separate main-scene AK/M4/Mark23 jump fixtures, standing and running, early/mid/late/landing/recovery from rear and side; repeat with --fire-before-jump. Source timing is adapted to current physics, not claimed as recovered original game timing.

system_delta.reason: Replace partial moving launch and standing-air substitution with copied seal_runningjump_launch (0–0.8s), seal_runningjump_in_air (0–0.43333333s), and matched seal_land_soft (0–0.6s). Running air blends its first 20 percent from launch; landing blends its first half from air. Standing phases stay separate. Original source assets, physics, local hip anchors and grip ownership remain unchanged. Verify source rotation samples, phase seams and rendered contacts.
